column1: # How the CI gate (`conformance.py gate`, .github/workflows/ci.yml) treats tests on a hosted runner.
# kind flaky: known to fail intermittently. It runs up to three times and never decides the job.
# kind skip: needs what a hosted runner does not have (this machine's GPU, the network, or timing a
# shared 4-core runner cannot keep). It is not run, and the job reports it as skipped, not passed.
